verdict.rationale: New Relic ships an official CLI (newrelic-cli) that supports entity search, tagging, and deployment markers, and a GraphQL-based NerdGraph API that can be scripted headlessly for querying/configuring—both usable in CI pipelines (e.g., recording deployment markers or querying NRQL as part of automation). However, there is no explicit documentation of CI-specific workflows, headless auth patterns, or examples of running the CLI/API in pipelines. Missing for 10: dedicated CI/CD integration guides, headless authentication docs, examples of automated pipeline usage, and independent confirmation of CLI reliability in CI contexts.
